teaser: A daily worker that turns eighteen years of essays, talks, posts and tools into linkable articles: then and now, connected, two or three a day.
core_idea: Most of Dinis's past work cannot be linked from what he writes now, so a worker takes one item a day from an inventoried back catalogue, writes what it said, what changed and how it connects, keeps a register, and compounds: each article is a node the next links to; every team can do the same, retrofitted backwards.
